newsitem.title: INDIA: SEBI receives India's Bank of Baroda IPO document.
newsitem.headline: SEBI receives India's Bank of Baroda IPO document.

text.p: Indian market regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Tuesday it received a draft prospectus of an 8.5 billion rupee initial public offer by Bank of Baroda, a major state-run bank.
The issue is lead-managed by ICICI Securities and Finance Company, the Indian affiliate of investment firm J.P.Morgan, and priced at 85 rupees per share of 10 rupees face value, it said.
SEBI said it also received the draft prospectus of a 1.8 billion rupee issue planned by Dena Bank, another state-run bank, to be lead-managed by SBI Capital Markets.
Dena Bank plans to issue each 10 rupee share at 30 rupees, it said. Both banks are now fully owned by the federal government.
